Kenji — thanks for sending this over and great to hear the demo landed.

Quick answers up front:
1) Field seller list: we can map the referral to MSFT sellers, but we need a crosswalk: Contoso Sales Org ID -> Account Owner. If you can share the tenant id or the MSFT seller alias list, we’ll match.
2) Account stitching: based on the PC report preview, I recommend stitching to the parent enterprise account (Contoso Global Corp) and creating sub-account tiles per BU (Contoso Retail, Contoso Cloud Ops, Contoso R&D). This prevents duplicate leads and makes quota attribution explicit.
3) Friction: none technical, but Contoso R&D has data residency asks (on-prem option). That will push Private deployment or dedicated capacity — flag for SLA.

I’ve drafted an initial account map (contoso_account_map_v1.xlsx) and a short mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan-contoso.pdf). I’m proposing a 30-min alignment call Thurs 12pm PT — does that work for you? If yes, we’ll loop in Kimberly for co-sell intake validation and Vanessa for seller triage.

–Mateo

Thanks Vanessa — quick technical read: stitching to the parent account is fine but two caveats:
1) Partner Center referral objects expect a single Account ID. If we stitch to the parent, ensure the sub-account tiles have unique external IDs mapped to the parent for telemetry aggregation.
2) MSFT seller crediting: we need the seller alias (email) on the MAP so Partner Center assigns credit. I can add a small automation to copy the alias into the PC intake record once confirmed.

I validated the sample spreadsheet and added an extra column for 'pc_seller_alias' — see contoso_account_map_v1.xlsx.
